title_en: After the Whistle with Brendan Hunt and Rebecca Lowe returns
excerpt_en: Apple’s hit podcast ‘After the Whistle with Brendan Hunt and Rebecca Lowe’ returns for a third season June 7, with commentary on the World Cup.
